meta.name: funding
meta.description: Funding round signal tracking for B2B outbound. Use when the user asks about funding signals, Series A/B/C detection, post-raise outreach, budget availability triggers, Crunchbase monitoring, or venture capital signals. Do NOT use for general company events (use company-events skill) or hiring that follows funding (use hiring skill).

copy.tagline: 发现B2B客户融资信号，把握外呼时机
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你做B2B销售，需要根据客户融资动态调整外呼策略
copy.tagline_en: Discover funding signals for B2B outreach timing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you do B2B sales and need to act on customer funding events

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能识别目标公司的融资轮次（种子轮到IPO），根据金额和轮次计算信号分数（如Series B为45分），确定最佳外呼时间（融资后2-4周），并生成以增长挑战为切入点的外呼模板。
howto.when: 当你询问融资信号、系列轮检测、融资后外呼、预算触发，或要求跟踪目标公司融资动态时触发。

say.text: 帮我追踪目标公司的融资动态
say.note: Claude会建议设置融资信号监控
输出分数、最佳时机和模板

say.text: 我需要融资驱动的外呼流程

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can identify funding rounds (Seed to IPO) for target accounts, calculate signal scores (e.g., Series B = 45 pts), determine optimal outreach timing (2-4 weeks post-funding), and generate outreach templates focused on growth challenges.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about funding signals, Series A/B/C detection, post-raise outreach, budget triggers, or request tracking of funding activity for target accounts.

say_en.text: Track funding rounds for my target accounts
say_en.note: Claude will suggest setting up funding signal monitoring
